FOUR HOUSES · ONE STANDARD

Fragrance for those who have nothing left to prove.

Maison Rare holds a small, deliberately incomplete collection — four eaux de parfum, each from an independent house, each made in volumes too small to advertise. We do not chase everyone. We hold the door for a few.

THE COLLECTION

Four bottles. No repeats.

Each house releases under a hundred bottles a season. Once a batch sells through, it does not return in the same form.

HOUSE OF AURAVÉ

Auravé

"Not just a scent, it's a presence."

A quiet amber built around white jasmine and sun-warmed sandalwood. Auravé sits close to the skin and stays there — the kind of fragrance people ask about only once they already know you well.

HEARTJasmine, orris

HOUSE OF NOCTARA

Noctara

"Dark notes. Soft presence. Unforgettable you."

Noctara opens sharp — black pepper and dark plum — before settling into a low, smoky base of oud and vanilla. Built for rooms, not for close conversation. It arrives before you do.

TOPBlack pepper, plum
HEARTDark rose, oud
BASEVanilla, smoked woods

HOUSE OF LUMIÈRE

Lumière

"A fragrance that speaks before you do."

Warm leather and amber resin, softened by a thread of cedar smoke. Lumière was built for a single moment — walking into a room you were not expected to leave an impression on.

"Not just a fragrance, it's a feeling."

The gentlest of the four — vanilla and jasmine over pale cedar, with none of the smoke the others carry. For the ones who feel deeply and would rather not announce it.

THE ATELIER

Why the bottles are few.

Scarcity here is not a marketing device. It's a batch size.

Sourced, not synthesized

Absolutes and resins bought in small lots from single growers, blended by hand in batches of under 400 bottles.

Built to outlast the evening

Every formula is weighted toward base notes, so what you wear at 7pm is still on your skin at 2am.

Never restocked identically

When a house sells through a season's batch, the next release is a new formula — not a reprint.

CONCIERGE

Prefer someone to choose for you?

Tell our concierge the room you're walking into, and we'll assemble a case of three from across the collection. No obligation to keep all three.

MAISON RARE

A small house of houses. We sell four fragrances at a time, deliberately, and stop when they're gone.
